anomalies.observed: R36 is valued 24k, but its description, footprint field and MPN all specify a 24Ω part ("24Ω 0805", MPN FRC0805J240TSD). The value is off by a factor of 1000 from the part actually described.
anomalies.expected: A 24Ω resistor between VOUTN and VOUTP, consistent with the part's description and MPN.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "R36") (value "24k") ... (description " 125mW Thick Film Resistors 150V ±100ppm/℃ ±5% 24Ω 0805 Chip Resistor - Surface Mount ROHS")

anomalies.impact: If the 24Ω part was intended, the value error changes the load or bleed behaviour on the VOUTP–VOUTN rail by 1000x. If the value is correct, the BOM and part description are wrong.

anomalies.observed: The second LED channel of dual LED D30 has its anode A2 (pin 4) on ESTOP_OUT, and its cathode K2 (pin 2) goes through R60 to ESTOP_OUT as well. The LED and its series resistor form a loop with both ends on the same net, so the channel cannot be forward-biased.
anomalies.expected: A status LED channel should have its anode and its series-resistor path on different nodes, so that current can flow when the signal is asserted. Channel 1 follows this pattern: A1 is on the LED enable net and K1 returns through R59 to GND.
anomalies.impact: The e-stop status LED for this channel never lights, so the operator gets no indication from it.

anomalies.observed: Q1, the ideal-diode P-channel FET, has its source (pin 2) on +5V (the load side) and its drain (pin 3) on USBC_VBUS_IN. The LTC4412 VIN pin is on USBC_VBUS_IN and SENSE is on +5V. The other P-FET power switches (Q6, Q9) have the source on the +5V input and the drain on the switched output.
anomalies.expected: For reverse-current protection the PFET source should be on the input (VBUS) and the drain on the load (+5V). The body diode then blocks reverse flow from +5V back to VBUS, as the note's stated purpose requires.
anomalies.impact: The body diode may conduct from the +5V rail back toward the USB input, so the reverse-current protection the design depends on may not work.

parsed.summary: The most concrete deviation is R36, whose value of 24k conflicts with its 24Ω description and MPN. Two lower-confidence concerns are a shorted e-stop LED channel in D30 and a possibly reversed source/drain on the USB ideal-diode FET Q1. The rest of the netlist, including the CAN, Ethernet, HDMI, USB and buffer-enable wiring, looks consistent with the spec.
